items.prompt: Repaint the supplied original Forbidden Arts Unleashed game card, square format. Input 1 is the authoritative original and edit target. Preserve its exact composition and transformed character design: frontal centered pale-blonde young woman, calm face with violet eyes, dark crescent hair ornament on viewer's right above bangs, long pale hair with large tied braid ends; black high-neck floor-length priest robe with restrained gold trim, dark purple hanging shoulder fabrics with ragged ends. Both arms opened to sides, palms up, at same height and same framing as original. Her hand on viewer's right holds a thin chain suspending a large angular silver star pendant at lower right. A giant black eclipse disc with white-violet crescent rim sits behind her head. Preserve original scale, silhouette, placement, hand pose, black outfit, purple eyes, eclipse and hanging star. Do not add a book or change her into normal white/teal clothes. Inputs 2-4 are style references only, do not copy their identities. Rough hand-painted anime color study, following style references 3-5 only for painting grammar: large connected opaque color masses, a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, handmade edges and selective unfinished areas. Group hair into substantial locks and cloth into principal fold planes. Clear anime features and readable hands; secondary regions coarse and quiet. Matte muted colors with concentrated purple/gold accents. No fine strands, dense wrinkles, facet mosaics, glossy rendering or all-over texture filters. Abstract pure-color backdrop. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
